newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Activity light after hours.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Activity light after hours.

text.p: After hours trading activity was very light Friday, traders said.
"There is nothing significant happening," said one trader.
The New York Stock Exchange said that the only issue unavailable for after hours trade Friday was Corimon SACA.
The NYSE said that session one volume was 1,600 shares, compared to 3,500 shares Thursday. There was no session two activity Friday, compared to volume of 1,789,100 Thursday.
The American Stock Exchange said that there was no after hours activity.
